Rey doesn't have any connection to anything. Phasma just dies in a fight. Those potential love stories? Fuck 'em. Poe's neutered now, and Flynn is off on a pointless sidequest... THAT'S THE MIDDLE, NOW OVER TO YOU!" It's little fucking wonder Abrams struggled to stick the landing. I don't know if it was the wisest decision for him to go "uh, I dunno what that was about, but anyway back to the story I was trying to tell" and maybe he should have carried on going off the rails, but it fucking baffles me that nobody thought to sit down and map a billion dollar franchise out first with some rough notes.
